Final categorization: REVIEW  
(Justification: The paper is explicitly labeled as a "Review article" and synthesizes existing research on climate change impacts on global wine production, including shifts in the geographic suitability of winegrowing regions. It discusses future projections of changing viticultural areas under different warming scenarios and touches on land use implications—such as expansion into new regions, conversion of farmland, and threats to natural habitats—thereby engaging with land use/land cover (LULC) change in the context of future predictions. Although LULC prediction is not the sole focus, the review integrates and assesses studies that involve spatial shifts in agricultural land use due to climate change, satisfying the criterion for a 'REVIEW' category as it touches on LULC future prediction.)
